q: Which of these is shared by all threads of the same process?
explain: Threads code, data, heap aur open files share karte hain; stack, registers aur program counter har thread ke apne hote hain.

q: fork() returns which value in the child process?
explain: Child mein fork() 0 return karta hai; parent mein child ka PID (>0); error par -1.

q: How many times is "hi" printed by: fork(); fork(); fork(); printf("hi");
explain: n consecutive fork() se 2^n processes bante hain; 3 fork -> 2^3 = 8 baar print.

q: A process that has finished but whose parent has not yet called wait() is called a:
explain: Zombie: child khatam par parent ne wait() nahi kiya, isliye process table mein entry pada reh jaata hai.

q: Which statement about a context switch is correct?
options: It does useful user work while switching
It is pure overhead; the OS saves/restores state via the PCB
It is the same thing as a mode switch
explain: Context switch mein koi user kaam nahi hota, sirf PCB mein state save/restore hoti hai; isliye pure overhead hai.
